title: The Pink Sock Sank
lines: Meg has a pink sock with mud on it.
She dips it in the sink. It sank!
Meg dips a cup in, then a mug.
She gets junk, but no pink sock.
Mom said, "Think. What is long and thin?"
Meg gets the thin net from the fish tank.
Tug, tug! Up pops the pink sock!
"Thank you, Mom," said Meg with a hug.
"Hang it up," said Mom. "Not in the sink!"

questions.ask: What happens to the pink sock in the sink?
questions.listenFor: It sank. If they say "it got wet," ask "and then what did it do?" to get them back to the word sank.

questions.ask: Meg tries a cup and a mug first. What gets the sock back in the end?
questions.listenFor: The thin net from the fish tank. Line seven says it. Mom gives a hint, but Meg fetches the net.

questions.ask: What do you think Meg should do next time? Tell me why.
questions.listenFor: Any sensible plan is fine. You are listening for a because, such as "hang it up, because it sank last time."
